limitations: Fixed 12-expert samples do not establish full-checkpoint compression.
CPU codec timings exclude model execution, GPU transfer and a real compressed storage implementation.
Catalog admission is separate from the 128MiB sample cap; native codec overhead is conservatively admitted, not hard capped.
Image functionality/quality is not qualified; vision, aligner and image-marker tensors are not modified or classified as unused.

memory_after.accounting: explicit buffers plus conservative existing component admissions; overlapping admissions may overestimate payload bytes

implementation.binary_identity_limitation: Built into Python; no independent extension file hash

plan.purpose: bounded lossless codec inventory; no adoption
